﻿## Guest Inbox
- Clearer thread and booking workspace actions, including a stepped create flow
- Combinable list filters, faster search, and lighter message snippets
- Touch-friendly Move sheet and clearer folder Hide / Stop watching / Delete labels
- Safer permanent delete (Trash only) and linked-import seeding that fills empty fields only

## Meals
- Aligned weekly meal-plan columns with conference chips and Assign-on-touch
- Wider recipe detail with Kitchen mode; recipe library compact grid / list with pagination
- Week groceries scaled from planned headcounts; clearer merge counts
- More readable A4 print (minimum type size) and safer conference-slot edits

## Fixes
- Mixed grocery quantity merges (for example 1 ½ + 1 ½)
